hero.subhead: The skill life-cycle manager for AI agents. Search, install, run, build, audit, and publish — one platform from spec to ship, without bolting six tools together.
hero.subheadStatic: The skill life-cycle manager for AI agents — search, install, build, publish, audit. One platform, every runtime.

lifecycle.ariaRing: Skill lifecycle — eight stages from search to share
lifecycle.hubSubtitle: One agent-facing API, from first search to shared skill — every runtime.

search.name: Search
search.title: Find the right skill
search.body: Your agent queries the registry by capability, tag, or natural language — and finds the skill before writing a line of glue code.

preview.name: Preview
preview.title: Inspect before you commit
preview.body: Read the SKILL.md, manifest, versions, and examples up front — know exactly what will run, no install required.

audit.name: Audit
audit.title: Versioned & audited
audit.body: Every release carries provenance, declared permissions, and a reviewable diff — so your agent only pulls what you trust.

install.name: Install
install.title: Pull on demand
install.body: Install a pinned, reproducible skill straight into your agent — model-agnostic, with no lock-in and no copy-paste.

execute.name: Execute
execute.title: Run in a sandbox
execute.body: Execute the skill in an isolated runtime (Node + Python), NyxID-gated for anything that needs credentials.

build.name: Build
build.title: Generate from a prompt
build.body: Describe a skill in plain English; ornn-build drafts a working SKILL.md you can iterate on and sandbox.

publish.name: Publish
publish.title: Publish in seconds
publish.body: Push to the registry and it goes live — versioned, audited, and ready for any agent to pull.

share.name: Share
share.title: Share anywhere
share.body: Hand it to your team or the world. The open skill format travels across Claude, GPT, Gemini, and custom agents.

why.pillar1Body: Skills live on a versioned, audited registry — not in Slack threads or random gists. Pull on demand from inside your agent via {{cmd}}.
why.pillar2Body: Describe the skill in plain English; {{cmd}} drafts a working SKILL.md you can iterate on, sandbox, and publish to the registry.
why.pillar2Proof: // ornn-build is itself a skill on the registry
why.pillar3Body: Platform-agnostic skill format with a sandbox playground (Node + Python) before you ship. NyxID-gated for anything that needs auth.

compare.subhead: A few things ORNN is often confused with, and what makes it different.
compare.row1UsSuffix: creates — you, your team, the world.
compare.row2UsSuffix: with a sandboxed runtime and audited, versioned releases.
compare.row3UsSuffix: — not Claude-locked. Skills travel with the agent that consumes them.
compare.row4Them: Not a runtime — execution happens in the agent.

install.body: Skills ship as plain markdown with manifest metadata — portable by design, with no glue code between runtimes. Today they pull into Claude Code; the format is open and agent-agnostic.

publish.body: You built something useful. Others need it too. Push to ORNN and it lives on the registry — versioned, audited, ready to pull into your agent.
publish.step2BodySuffix: (Node + Python). NyxID-gated for anything that needs auth.
publish.step3Body: One command. Versioned, audited, live on the registry.

footer.tagline: The end-to-end skill life-cycle manager for AI agents.

frontmatter.envVarFormat: Environment variable names must be UPPER_SNAKE_CASE
frontmatter.nameFormat: Name must start with a letter or number and contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens
frontmatter.versionFormat: version must be in `<major>.<minor>` format, e.g. `1.0` (non-negative integers, no leading zeroes, no patch digit)
frontmatter.versionInvalidType: version must be a quoted string — write `version: "0.1"` in SKILL.md, not `version: 0.1` (YAML parses the unquoted form as a number and loses the trailing zero).
frontmatter.tagInvalidType: tags must be non-empty lowercase strings with optional hyphens, e.g. `tag: [my-tag]` — an empty `- ` line in YAML parses as `null` and is not a valid tag.
frontmatter.envVarInvalidType: runtime-env-var entries must be non-empty UPPER_SNAKE_CASE strings, e.g. `runtime-env-var: [OPENAI_API_KEY]` — an empty `- ` line in YAML parses as `null`.
frontmatter.toolInvalidType: tool-list entries must be non-empty strings, e.g. `tool-list: [Bash, Read]` — an empty `- ` line in YAML parses as `null`.
frontmatter.runtimeInvalidType: runtime entries must be non-empty strings, e.g. `runtime: [python]` — an empty `- ` line in YAML parses as `null`.
frontmatter.dependencyInvalidType: runtime-dependency entries must be non-empty strings, e.g. `runtime-dependency: [requests==2.31]` — an empty `- ` line in YAML parses as `null`.
